rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Pale cool surface with ice-like crystals at edges
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of a pale cool-grey #E5E9EA and off-white #F4F2EE surface with small clear ice-like crystals and a few droplets only in the outer left and right edges and along the bottom edge. Lighting: bright soft light from the upper left at 5600K at 6000K, very soft shadows falling to the lower right. Background: matte, smooth gradient, shallow depth. Style: laboratory still life, crisp and precise. The top band, about 20% of the height, is intentionally empty, calm and low-detail for headline copy added later. The middle band, from 20% to 70% of the height and across 90% of the width, is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for photos placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.

asset_requirements: real pack shot composited by the tool
